title: Record release 1.7.0 as tagged and TypeScript 0.12.1 as available on GitHub Packages from dated consumer evidence (REQ-release-5), with Rust 0.7.0 still pending and crates.io serving 0.6.0
description: Record release 1.7.0 as tagged and TypeScript 0.12.1 as available on GitHub Packages from dated consumer evidence (REQ-release-5), with Rust 0.7.0 still pending and crates.io serving 0.6.0
no_spec_change_rationale: Docs-only correction: docs/RELEASE.md, ts/README.md and ts/index.html still say v1.7.0 is not yet tagged and TypeScript 0.12.1 is not yet published; they are brought in line with REQ-release-5 (availability recorded from dated external-consumer evidence) after the tag and publication on 2026-11-11; no requirement, contract or code changes
acceptance_criteria: docs/RELEASE.md records release 1.7.0 as tagged (v1.7.0 is commit aadcf738, the squash merge of #89, with a GitHub Release) and v1.6.2 as the previous release; it records TypeScript 0.12.1 as available on GitHub Packages since 2026-11-11 in a dated evidence section (publish-npm.yml run 42941689248 from tag v1.7.0, registry shasum and gitHead, contents identical to npm pack of ts/ at v1.7.0, and an external consumer that installs it and checks vector 07); it keeps Rust 0.7.0 as not yet published with crates.io serving 0.6.0 until publish-crates.yml runs; ts/README.md and ts/index.html say GitHub Packages serves 0.12.1 and their install commands pin 0.12.1. No code, packaging, spec or requirement changes.
